from.place: Proof, step 2 (blueprint proof, third paragraph): a central simple algebra over E descends to a finite extension of k(C), where Tsen's theorem splits it.

title: Brauer vanishing for an algebraic extension of a curve function field
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field, let C/k be an integral connected curve [def-sc-curves], let L be an algebraic extension of the function field of C [def-sc-function-field], and let E be a finite-dimensional separable field extension of L [def-pc-field-extension], [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Then $H^2(\operatorname{Spec}(E)_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_m)$ is the zero group, with etale cohomology and $\mathbf G_m$ as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and [def-sc-gm-torsor].
